user.title: Add Thermex range hood
user.description:
Enter the hood's Bluetooth address.

Home Assistant normally finds the hood by itself. If it did not, the most likely reason is that a phone is connected to it — the hood accepts one connection at a time and stops advertising while it is in use. Turn off Bluetooth on any phone paired with it and try again.

confirm.title: Add Thermex range hood
confirm.description: Set up the hood found at {address}?

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect. Check the address, make sure no phone is connected to the hood, and that the hood is in range of Home Assistant or a Bluetooth proxy.
error.not_found: Home Assistant has not heard this hood advertise. Make sure no phone is connected to it, and that it is in range of Home Assistant or a Bluetooth proxy.

abort.already_configured: This hood is already set up.
